facts.business: Quess Corp is one of India's leading workforce management and staffing solutions companies, delivering integrated services across general staffing, professional staffing, overseas workforce deployment, and digital employment platforms.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Dividend policy: return up to 75% of free cash flow to shareholders in the form of interim and/or final dividend and/or share buy-back over a block of 3 (three) years cumulatively.
